traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Drive meets imagination. Energy steered by vision and a persuasive, magnetic pull. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Charismatic motivation; action aligned with imagination. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize drive and imagination into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what drive and imagination have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Inspiring and persuasive; keep the aim concrete or the drive dissipates.
shadow: The ease lets anger and recklessness and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.body: A strong feeling finds one concrete action before it scatters into frustration. Mars sextile Neptune can turn grief, outrage, hope, or creative urgency into a fundraiser, volunteer shift, performance, or direct request that gives people somewhere useful to put their energy. The action does not have to solve the entire problem to matter. It needs a clear purpose and a person who can receive the help. Choose the next task people can actually complete, then let the larger feeling stay larger than the assignment.
